videoBrief.title: CCW Boardroom — Episode 1: The Operating System for Equipment Suppliers
videoBrief.description: The inaugural CCW Boardroom session. Meet the board, review the platform build status, and learn what CCW ERP means for Australian equipment suppliers.

buildReason: Platform at 82% production readiness. 14 modules live, video pipeline complete, RLS security deployed across all tables. Remaining: Xero OAuth, Stripe webhook activation, YouTube content ramp.
intelligence:
Australian equipment suppliers lose $2.3B annually to manual inventory processes and disconnected systems.
The cleaning equipment market is growing 8.2% YoY — fastest in the trades sector.
Competitors are still on legacy ERPs (MYOB, Reckon) with zero AI integration — CCW has a 12-month head start.

boardOutputs.architect: The modular architecture is proving its worth. 14 independently deployable modules with zero cross-contamination. The Remotion video pipeline ships training content without touching the core ERP. Next priority: decouple the Cin7 sync engine into a standalone service.
boardOutputs.revenue_guardian: With 35 active customers and a 38.9% quote conversion rate, the pipeline is healthy. The immediate revenue unlock is Stripe billing activation — recurring SaaS revenue from day one. Focus: convert the 7 pending quotes worth $850K+ in pipeline value.
boardOutputs.agent_whisperer: The AI agent framework is operational with 14 Superpowers skills and 29 gstack commands. The boardroom CRON runs autonomously. Next frontier: Agent Teams with parallel execution — each teammate in its own context window solves the token limit bottleneck.
boardOutputs.integration_maestro: Shopify and Xero are the two client-facing connections — everything else is CCW infrastructure. The 2-connection onboarding flow means clients are live in under 10 minutes. Priority: complete Xero OAuth setup on Railway to unlock accounting sync.

moonShot: Imagine every equipment supplier in Australia running their entire operation from a single AI-powered dashboard. Orders, inventory, customers, suppliers, invoicing — all connected, all intelligent, all autonomous. That is what CCW is building. The equipment industry has never had purpose-built software. We are changing that.
